text:
Ellen C: Found a raw GCP SA JSON inside partner upload s3://partner-ingest/prod/2026-04-10/payload.ndjson (line ~42). private_key present. Need containment and rotation. @Akshay can you triage?
Akshay: Acknowledged. Immediate plan: quarantine object, disable key, rotate Vault secret, rewrap with KMS, tighten RBAC, enable audit shipping. Quarantining now.
Ravi: Quick Vault check shows secret/partners/partnerZ/ingest has field `service_account_json`. Looks like raw JSON was written.
Platform Team: Short-term mitigation: add an upload validator to reject files containing "private_key" and auto-quarantine. We'll raise an emergency ticket. Long-term: require envelope encryption or WIF.
sre-bot: Created alert `vault.read.anomaly.partnerz` -> routed to #incidents and oncall.
Akshay: Disabled key KEY_Z_987 at 2026-04-10T11:05:30Z, fingerprint SHA256:FEEDFACE0011. Deleting now and creating replacement with least-priv. Will store wrapped key at secret/partners/partnerZ/ingest-v2.
Ellen C: Partner and CS notified. Legal looped in for disclosure assessment. Please post deletion confirmation when done.
Akshay: Deleted old key. Created new SA redwood-ingest-partnerz-temp@project, generated key, wrapped with KMS, wrote to `secret/partners/partnerZ/ingest-v2`. Pushed temporary Vault policy to deny CI runners read access to the compromised path.
Ravi: Kicked off repo and logs scan for occurrences of the old SA email and private_key strings. Found one unusual unwrap call at 2026-04-09T23:58 from partner IP range; exporting to incident doc.
Akshay: Rewrapped backups referencing old creds and rotated cached tokens. Restarted ingest workers to pick up new secret. Setting short TTL on new key and monitoring 48h.
Platform Team: Adding ingest validation rule this sprint; emergency hotfix to run a nightly scan over partner buckets.
Legal: We need incident notice draft and impact summary. Share timeline and any evidence of external access.
Ellen C: Will collate logs and add to incident doc. Leaving thread open for further anomalies. :white_check_mark:
